# Balanced identifier replacement and retention

Continue from v16 with 609 presentations: 369 familiar targets, eight additional copies of four failed replacement states, 32 balanced replacement/retention variants repeated three times, 64 numeric rehearsal cases and 48 negative sorts. Preserve independent recipient and privacy decisions. No application prompts, sampling or MCP capabilities change.

Freeze 84 fresh cases before inference: 36 drafts (including 16 replacement/retention states with changed question wording and order), 20 bounds, 24 sorts and four general checks. Compare base, immediate parent and historical v8 using the unchanged v8 evaluator. Use the unchanged v7 trainer at the settings in protocol.json. Candidate fresh inference follows a recorded acquisition decision. Manual review must retain every field, prohibition and explicit replacement; contradictory fields fail. An explicit final replacement qualifier may resolve an earlier field mention, consistently with v16 review.

The release objective is petya-v1. This experiment alone cannot establish readiness. Release requires acquisition retention, independent fresh improvements without paired regressions, diverse multi-turn checks and verified runtime integration. Do not promote a failing candidate or describe exact JSON scores as semantic scores. Training has not yet started.
